references.text: Balaam had previously asked Balak to stand by his burnt offering while he went to meet the Lord, and here he returns and finds Balak standing by the sacrifice.
A similar scene repeats itself as Balaam comes back to Balak, who is standing by his burnt offering together with the princes of Moab.
The princes of Moab are mentioned as those who accompanied Balak in his attempt to get Balaam to curse Israel.
Balak sacrificed and took Balaam to the high places, which forms the background for the sacrifice scene in this verse.
Balaam instructed Balak to build seven altars and offer seven bulls and seven rams, which is the burnt offering he now stands by.
